_help: This file is YOUR control panel. 'hidden' = repos to hide everywhere (frontend + chatbot). 'pinned' = repos to show first, in this order. 'overrides' = your polished copy for a repo, used instead of GitHub's plain description. Any repo not mentioned here still shows automatically using its GitHub info. Matching is case-insensitive, so lowercase keys match repos of any case. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the code.

portfolio-ai.description: Production-deployed RAG assistant answering questions about my portfolio. Hybrid retrieval fuses FAISS dense search with BM25 using Reciprocal Rank Fusion, behind a two-level exact-then-semantic answer cache whose threshold was set by an evidence-based sweep. Streams token-by-token over SSE, syncs its project list live from GitHub, and is scored by a RAGAS eval harness. FastAPI on Render, frontend on Vercel.

ai-codebase-tutor.description: An onboarding tutor for unfamiliar codebases. Runs as an agent, investigating any repo in multiple hops and citing every claim to exact file lines or a commit SHA. Hybrid BM25 + FAISS retrieval with RRF fusion, cross-encoder reranking, symbol-level AST chunking and call-graph expansion. Also generates architecture diagrams, an onboarding walkthrough, and a git-archaeology evolution doc. Every retrieval upgrade is measured with hit_rate@k, recall@k and MRR — not asserted.

careroute.description: An agentic assistant that reasons from a patient's complaint to the specialty they need, then calls tools to pull the clinical record and find the nearest matching providers. Built twice with proven behavioural parity — a hand-rolled tool-calling loop and a LangGraph StateGraph port — pinned by an offline golden-transcript harness needing no API key. A deterministic code-level guard withholds any provider no tool confirmed, because prompt instructions alone did not hold.

email-classifier.description: A Gmail auto-labeler sorting mail into a fixed six-class taxonomy entirely on-device, so email content never leaves the machine. The classifier is DistilBERT fine-tuned by knowledge distillation: GPT-4o-mini labels the dataset once, offline, and at inference the LLM is gone completely. Diagnosed rare-class collapse from the confusion matrix and applied inverse-frequency class weights, lifting macro-F1 from 0.67 to 0.95.

rag-document-chatbot.description: Multimodal document Q&A over PDFs, scanned pages, handwritten notes and photos. A per-page router reads trustworthy text layers directly and sends scanned or corrupted pages to a vision LLM — including a trust check that catches the broken-glyph failure mode of Indic-script PDFs. Vision extraction is structured for retrieval, keeping table row and column labels intact. Nothing is persisted: each session gets its own in-memory FAISS index.

travel-ai.description: A voice-first travel planner for groups. Runs a guided spoken conversation, captures each participant's interests separately, and only generates the itinerary once everyone has contributed. Deliberately splits LLM work from deterministic work: group ranking is frequency aggregation and duration parsing is plain code, so the parts that must be predictable never depend on a model.

email-spam-filter.description: End-to-end spam filter: TF-IDF n-grams + Logistic Regression with class balancing. Beats a Naive Bayes baseline through thoughtful feature engineering and regex preprocessing. Served in real time via a Flask API — not just a notebook, an actual product.
